preflight_attempts.disposition: Runner rejected an invalid memory-share divisor before starting dumpbin. Export inspection then completed with divisor 18.

method.route_order: Three cyclic rotations on each cohort, with cohort order alternating between rounds. ABI 8 and ABI 10 used the same helper, kernel package, installed runtime and Windows controller.
method.cohorts: Both controlled cohorts mask the staged differences at the CPU sampler's eight positions. One derives the bases from public-file samples and the other uses deterministic synthetic bytes.
method.size: Compacted protected indexed image extent, including both mirrored payload copies and metadata.
method.timing: Wall-clock sum of route discovery, maintenance and independent compacted-image verification. Fixture construction is outside that interval.
method.cpu_route: Sampled reference selection with CPU encoding.
method.amd_sampled_route: Same sampled reference selection with device sparse-XOR candidate generation and independent CPU verification.
method.amd_full_route: Two admitted reference candidates per fully resident group. Device sparse and dense XOR price across all tiles, with selected sparse candidates checked by CPU.
method.automation: Idle opportunities modeled by the controller fixture. GPU use explicitly selected for this comparison. CPU remains the default.
method.scope: Sizes and timings apply to the measured controlled workloads and installed adapter. The comparison does not evaluate CPU full-tile pricing, natural-corpus generalization, automatic background interference, mounted I/O or power-loss durability.
